name: basic-async-operations-test-5353eae739/async-non-native-basic8-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions / Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported" (ballerina/lang.future and cancel are absent)
Subset restrictions / Invocations / Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" (future:cancel is absent)
reason: The asserted panic depends on cancelling both started futures and then checkpanic-waiting on their alternative. Future cancellation via f1.cancel() and f2.cancel() is outside the supported langlib and method-call positive lists, so the complete cancellation/panic behavior is a feature case despite start and wait being listed.
unsupported_constructs: future:cancel via f1.cancel() and f2.cancel(), including cancellation-induced wait error/panic behavior
test_design_notes: @panic asserts cancellation-induced failure of checkpanic wait f1 | f2; signatures or generic start/wait support do not establish cancellation support.
